spec_match.rationale: Builds the explainer's own motivating SPA scenario: write-only interface, page-side ledger, removeWords(outgoing)+addWords(incoming) per view switch, drain-on-signout — each switch making the real calls.

interactive.rationale: Three view tabs with aria-pressed state drive real API calls, a live ledger, and a per-switch call log.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the write-only design point made operational; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Empty-outgoing and empty-incoming switches are skipped-not-faked; the sign-out view proves the ledger drains; unavailable surface logs per call.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/6185007701557248; the page links the explainer's removeWords rationale.

conformance.rationale: The suite's write-only-no-read-surface assertion is this page's premise as a checkable contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: switched Pokédex→Trading-desk→Sign-out; ledger showed the four tickers then drained to empty, with every real call's honest not-attempted outcome logged; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: scd-spa-switch asserts per switch with counts and call outcomes.

design_system.rationale: Unpressed tabs invert bg/color with borders; ledger chips on stone (AA); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Tabs carry aria-pressed; the view box and ledger are aria-live; the call log is role=log; ≥44px tabs.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Tabs and chips wrap; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Toggle-style view switches need programmatic pressed state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All three tabs manage aria-pressed on every switch.
The ledger is aria-live with an explicit empty-state message.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the ledger logic — the half the API deliberately leaves to pages — works everywhere, and every switch's real API calls report genuine outcomes on Chromium 141. No open questions beyond the feature-wide flag-on run recorded on the sibling pages.
